WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) = 'youtube men's vintage henley'
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
),
customer_purchases_all_time AS (
  SELECT qc.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM qualifying_customers qc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
    ON qc.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE LOWER(p.v2ProductName) != 'youtube men's vintage henley'
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY qc.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM customer_purchases_all_time
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH product_revenue_check AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s, UNNEST(s.hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId
),
session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.date,
    s.totals.pageviews,
    s.totals.transactions,
    COALESCE(pr.has_product_revenue, 0) as has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
  LEFT JOIN product_revenue_check pr ON s.fullVisitorId = pr.fullVisitorId
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    pageviews,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue = 1 THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND has_product_revenue = 0 THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_data
)
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
  session_type,
  AVG(pageviews) as avg_pageviews
FROM classified
WHERE session_type IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

-- Final answer: provider with highest combined average costs (inpatient + outpatient) using average_total_payments
WITH inpatient AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 
         AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_inpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
),
outpatient AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, 
         AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_outpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
)
SELECT i.provider_id, i.provider_name, 
       ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment, 2) as avg_inpatient_payment,
       ROUND(o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) as avg_outpatient_payment,
       ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment + o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) as combined_avg_cost
FROM inpatient i
JOIN outpatient o ON i.provider_id = o.provider_id
ORDER BY combined_avg_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT nppes_provider_state, 
       SUM(total_claim_count) as total_claim_count,
       SUM(total_drug_cost) as total_drug_cost
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE drug_name = 'AMLODIPINE BESYLATE'
GROUP BY nppes_provider_state
ORDER BY total_claim_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH RECURSIVE snomed_descendants AS (
  SELECT 141095 AS snomed_root, 141095 AS descendant_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 133834, 133834
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 140168, 140168
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 138502, 138502
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sd.snomed_root, cr.concept_id_2 AS descendant_id
  FROM snomed_descendants sd
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
    ON sd.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
all_snomed_descendants AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT snomed_root, descendant_id
  FROM snomed_descendants
),
total_participants AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS total_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
),
condition_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    sd.snomed_root,
    COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS participant_count
  FROM all_snomed_descendants sd
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co
    ON sd.descendant_id = co.condition_concept_id
  GROUP BY sd.snomed_root
),
mapping AS (
  SELECT concept_id_1 AS snomed_concept_id, concept_id_2 AS icd10_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE relationship_id = 'Mapped from'
    AND concept_id_2 IN (1569798, 1569765, 1569777, 35208655)
)
SELECT 
  icd.concept_code AS icd10_code,
  icd.concept_name AS condition_name,
  COALESCE(cc.participant_count, 0) AS participant_count,
  tp.total_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(cc.participant_count, 0), tp.total_count) * 100 AS percentage
FROM mapping m
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` icd
  ON m.icd10_concept_id = icd.concept_id
LEFT JOIN condition_counts cc
  ON m.snomed_concept_id = cc.snomed_root
CROSS JOIN total_participants tp
ORDER BY icd.concept_code

WITH combined AS (
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
),
monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wbt,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewp,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM combined
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL 
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month,
  ABS(avg_air - avg_wbt) + 
  ABS(avg_air - avg_dewp) + 
  ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) + 
  ABS(avg_wbt - avg_dewp) + 
  ABS(avg_wbt - avg_sst) + 
  ABS(avg_dewp - avg_sst) as sum_abs_diff
FROM monthly_avgs
ORDER BY sum_abs_diff
LIMIT 3

WITH rochester_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(year || '-' || mo || '-' || da AS DATE) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290'
    AND year = '2019'
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
converted AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    (temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0 AS temp_c,
    prcp_in * 2.54 AS prcp_cm,
    wdsp_knots * 0.514444 AS wdsp_ms
  FROM rochester_data
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    ROUND(temp_c, 1) AS temp,
    ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) AS precipitation,
    ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) AS wind_speed,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prec_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wind_ma8
  FROM converted
)
SELECT
  date,
  temp,
  precipitation,
  wind_speed,
  temp_ma8,
  prec_ma8,
  wind_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(prec_ma8 - LAG(prec_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prec_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wind_lag8_diff
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) AS max_precip_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) AS min_temp_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) AS max_temp_c
FROM (
  SELECT id, date, element, value, qflag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2013`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, date, element, value, qflag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2014`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, date, element, value, qflag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2015`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, date, element, value, qflag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
)
WHERE date >= DATE_SUB(DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS STRING), '-12-31')), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
  AND (qflag IS NULL OR qflag = '')
  AND value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH 
-- Count non-dead trees per species in 1995
count_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) as non_dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE UPPER(spc_latin) NOT IN ('PLANTING SITE', 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES', 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES', 'UNKNOWN STUMP', 'STUMP', 'PINUS SPECIES')
    AND UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`)
    AND status != 'Dead'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Count alive trees per species in 2015
count_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as spc_latin_upper,
    COUNT(*) as alive_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
    AND UPPER(spc_latin) IN (SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`)
    AND status = 'Alive'
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
-- Combine and compute difference
species_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(c1.spc_latin_upper, c2.spc_latin_upper) as spc_latin_upper,
    COALESCE(c1.non_dead_count, 0) as count_1995,
    COALESCE(c2.alive_count, 0) as count_2015,
    COALESCE(c1.non_dead_count, 0) - COALESCE(c2.alive_count, 0) as diff
  FROM count_1995 c1
  FULL OUTER JOIN count_2015 c2 ON c1.spc_latin_upper = c2.spc_latin_upper
)
SELECT 
  ts.fall_color,
  SUM(sd.diff) as total_change
FROM species_diff sd
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = sd.spc_latin_upper
GROUP BY ts.fall_color
ORDER BY total_change DESC

WITH all_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    total_amount,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01' AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01' AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    total_amount,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01' AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01' AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
)
SELECT 
  pz.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  dz.zone_name AS dropoff_zone,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS trip_duration_seconds,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(t.trip_distance, SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS FLOAT64), 3600.0)) AS driving_speed_mph,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 AS tip_rate_pct,
  t.total_amount
FROM all_trips t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz ON t.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz ON t.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
WHERE t.passenger_count > 5
  AND t.trip_distance >= 10
  AND t.tip_amount >= 0
  AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
  AND t.mta_tax >= 0
  AND t.fare_amount >= 0
  AND t.total_amount >= 0
  AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
ORDER BY t.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT country_name, indicator_name, indicator_code, year, value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population` WHERE country_name IN ('United States', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran') AND year = 2020 ORDER BY country_name, indicator_name LIMIT 30

SELECT 
  c.county_name as county_name,
  c.state as state,
  ROUND(cd.median_age, 1) as median_age,
  ROUND(cd.total_pop, 0) as total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c._2020_08_27 * 100000.0, cd.total_pop), 1) as cases_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100000.0, cd.total_pop), 1) as deaths_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100.0, c._2020_08_27), 2) as case_fatality_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.confirmed_cases` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.deaths` d
  ON c.county_fips_code = d.county_fips_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2020_5yr` cd 
  ON CAST(c.county_fips_code AS STRING) = CAST(cd.geo_id AS STRING)
WHERE cd.total_pop > 50000
  AND c._2020_08_27 > 0
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100.0, c._2020_08_27) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
    a.geo_id,
    a.median_income AS income_2015,
    b.median_income AS income_2018,
    b.median_income - a.median_income AS increase
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` b
    ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '06%'
ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH scoring_events AS (
  SELECT 
    period,
    game_clock,
    team_name,
    points_scored,
    event_description,
    elapsed_time_sec
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
    AND points_scored > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec ASC, event_description ASC) as rn
  FROM scoring_events
)
SELECT 
  r1.period,
  r1.game_clock,
  r1.team_name,
  r1.points_scored,
  r1.event_description,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r2.points_scored) FROM ranked r2 
   WHERE r2.period = r1.period AND r2.team_name = 'Wildcats' 
     AND (r2.rn < r1.rn OR (r2.rn = r1.rn AND r2.event_description <= r1.event_description))), 0) 
   + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r3.points_scored) FROM ranked r3 
   WHERE r3.period < r1.period AND r3.team_name = 'Wildcats'), 0) as wildcats_score,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r4.points_scored) FROM ranked r4 
   WHERE r4.period = r1.period AND r4.team_name = 'Fighting Irish' 
     AND (r4.rn < r1.rn OR (r4.rn = r1.rn AND r4.event_description <= r1.event_description))), 0)
   + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r5.points_scored) FROM ranked r5 
   WHERE r5.period < r1.period AND r5.team_name = 'Fighting Irish'), 0) as irish_score
FROM ranked r1
ORDER BY r1.period, r1.elapsed_time_sec ASC, r1.event_description ASC

WITH max_wins_per_season AS (
  SELECT season, MAX(wins) as max_wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons`
  WHERE season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000 AND name IS NOT NULL AND name != ''
  GROUP BY season
),
peak_teams AS (
  SELECT mts.market, mts.name, mts.season, mts.wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons` mts
  JOIN max_wins_per_season mws
    ON mts.season = mws.season
  WHERE mts.season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND mts.name IS NOT NULL 
    AND mts.name != ''
    AND mts.wins = mws.max_wins
)
SELECT market, COUNT(*) as peak_seasons
FROM peak_teams
GROUP BY market
ORDER BY peak_seasons DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    total_employed_in_thousands,
    percent_women,
    percent_white,
    percent_black_or_african_american,
    percent_asian,
    percent_hispanic_or_latino
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
  AND (
    (sector = 'Information' AND subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals')
    OR (industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services')
  )
),
bls_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(percent_asian * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) * 100, 1) AS asian_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(percent_black_or_african_american * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) * 100, 1) AS black_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(percent_hispanic_or_latino * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) * 100, 1) AS hispanic_latinx_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(percent_white * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) * 100, 1) AS white_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(percent_women * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) * 100, 1) AS us_women_pct,
    ROUND(SUM((1 - percent_women) * total_employed_in_thousands) / SUM(total_employed_in_thousands) * 100, 1) AS us_men_pct
  FROM bls_tech
)
SELECT 
  'Google Overall Hiring' AS source,
  'Overall' AS workforce_type,
  ROUND(race_asian * 100, 1) AS asian_pct,
  ROUND(race_black * 100, 1) AS black_pct,
  ROUND(race_hispanic_latinx * 100, 1) AS hispanic_latinx_pct,
  ROUND(race_white * 100, 1) AS white_pct,
  ROUND(gender_us_women * 100, 1) AS us_women_pct,
  ROUND(gender_us_men * 100, 1) AS us_men_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Google Overall Representation' AS source,
  'Overall' AS workforce_type,
  ROUND(race_asian * 100, 1) AS asian_pct,
  ROUND(race_black * 100, 1) AS black_pct,
  ROUND(race_hispanic_latinx * 100, 1) AS hispanic_latinx_pct,
  ROUND(race_white * 100, 1) AS white_pct,

  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'

  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD'
    AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53')

patient_mutations AS (

    MAX(CASE WHEN Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_mutations
  GROUP BY patient_id
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT 
    c.patient_id,
    COALESCE(m.has_kras, 0) as has_kras,
    COALESCE(m.has_tp53, 0) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_clinical c
  LEFT JOIN patient_mutations m ON c.patient_id = m.patient_id
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d
  FROM patient_status
)
SELECT 
  a as kras_positive_tp53_positive,
  b as kras_positive_tp53_negative,
  c as kras_negative_tp53_positive,
  d as kras_negative_tp53_negative,
  (a + b + c + d) as total_patients,
  (a + b) as kras_total,
  (c + d) as no_kras_total,
  (a + c) as tp53_total,
  (b + d) as no_tp53_total,
  ROUND(
    (a + b + c + d) * POWER(a * d - b * c, 2) * 1.0 / ((a + b) * (c + d) * (a + c) * (b + d)),
    4
  ) as chi_squared_statistic
FROM contingency

-- Calculate the average difference in pageviews between purchasers and non-purchasers
WITH dec_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
pageview_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(*) as pageview_count
  FROM dec_events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
purchasers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM dec_events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN pv.pageview_count ELSE NULL END) 
  - 
  AVG(CASE WHEN p.user_pseudo_id IS NULL THEN pv.pageview_count ELSE NULL END) as avg_difference_pageviews
FROM pageview_counts pv
LEFT JOIN purchasers p ON pv.user_pseudo_id = p.user_pseudo_id

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') as ga_session_id,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') as page_title
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102` e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
    AND (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') IS NOT NULL
),
session_pages AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN page_title = 'Home' THEN page_title END) as has_home,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN page_title = 'Checkout Confirmation' THEN page_title END) as has_checkout
  FROM page_views
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_home > 0 THEN ga_session_id END) as sessions_with_home,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_home > 0 AND has_checkout > 0 THEN ga_session_id END) as sessions_with_both,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_home > 0 AND has_checkout > 0 THEN ga_session_id END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_home > 0 THEN ga_session_id END)
  ) * 100 as conversion_rate_pct
FROM session_pages

WITH event_session AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING) END)
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) ep) as session_id,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'session_engaged' THEN ep.value.string_value END)
     FROM UNNEST(event_params) ep) as is_engaged
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
session_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    session_id,
    MAX(is_engaged) as session_engaged
  FROM event_session
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, session_id
),
user_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_sessions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN session_engaged = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as engaged_sessions
  FROM session_agg
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT AVG(engaged_sessions) as avg_engaged_sessions_per_user
FROM user_sessions

WITH event_params_flat AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT ev.value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ev WHERE ev.key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id,
    ep.key AS param_key,
    ep.value.string_value AS param_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN param_key = 'medium' THEN param_value END) AS medium,
    MAX(CASE WHEN param_key = 'source' THEN param_value END) AS source,
    MAX(CASE WHEN param_key = 'campaign' THEN param_value END) AS campaign
  FROM event_params_flat
  WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
),
session_channel AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN campaign IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(campaign) LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR campaign IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'(?:^|[^a-df-z])shop(?:ping)?'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
           OR (campaign IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'(?:^|[^a-df-z])shop(?:ping)?')) THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*video.*') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS traffic_channel
  FROM session_params
)
SELECT traffic_channel, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
FROM session_channel
GROUP BY traffic_channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

user_first AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_name as initial_event_type,
    event_date as initial_event_date
  FROM user_all_events
  WHERE rn = 1
)
